description: Pinned PULP APB3 I2C master, one 7-bit electrical slave, one-byte read and held native IRQ.

resets.release: The controller uses asynchronous active-low HRESETn. Release must satisfy HCLK recovery/removal timing.

port_actions.reason: Native registered level from irq_flag and IEN; source remains high until IACK, but no CPU IRQ binding is declared in this local profile.

semantics: All 17 physical top ports are accounted for: clock/reset, eight APB3 fields, six open-drain pin fields and observed interrupt_o.
APB address decoding uses PADDR[5:2]; only full-word writes are accepted because there is no PSTRB. PREADY=1 and PSLVERR=0.
scl_pad_o and sda_pad_o are constant zero; respective active-low output-enable pins determine drive-low or release. Pad inputs receive resolved pull-up and peer states.
Control bit 7 enables the core and bit 6 enables IRQ; command bits [7:4] are START/STOP/READ/WRITE and bit 0 acknowledges IRQ. IRQ is held from command completion until IACK.
The upstream byte controller uses #1 simulation delays; the generated Verilator executable selects --no-timing, which ignores those delays and preserves edge-clocked state updates.
Generated peer is a deterministic 7-bit slave at address 0x42. It ACKs the address and supplies byte 0xa5 on one master read while resolving both open-drain pads with pull-ups.
Accepted software sequence writes prescaler 2..16, CTRL=0xc0, TX=0x85, CMD=0x90; after native IRQ, CMD=0x01 acknowledges, then CMD=0x68 performs one byte read, NACK and STOP.
verified: Four pinned source files and include closure replay under Verilator; 12 nonfatal warnings are recorded.
unknown: This harness admits one deterministic I2C slave peer only; multi-master arbitration and clock stretching are unsupported.
Other APB_ADDR_WIDTH values and partial writes are not admitted.
Prescaler 0 or 1 is rejected because the pinned controller input filter and peer observed malformed sampling at those speeds.
Other addresses, repeated starts, multi-byte operations and write payloads are outside the accepted generated session.
